policy: Environment-disabled ephemeral app-server thread; only allowlisted dynamic app file reads/writes and read-only layout packet. No shell, built-in filesystem, execution, connectors, web, plugins, hooks or memories. Reject traversal, links/junctions and hardlinks. Trusted host and build/verification processes are not OS-sandboxed. Adapter, evaluation code, fixtures, and reference outputs are outside the model capability boundary.
builder_protection: Allowlisted file tools only; not OS sandboxing. No unrestricted shell, code execution or browser-evaluation capability. Verification hosts and isolated test fixtures are outside the builder tool surface.
